# Unlocking the world’s generosity potential

We’re a technology company unlocking the world’s generosity potential by optimizing how people give.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 3000 1728'%3E%3C/svg%3E)![](https://max.ucarecdn.com/b8a041fd-7dc0-47c2-a029-21dbcdbb22f9/-/preview/80x80/-/format/auto/-/quality/lighter/-/blur/36/)![](https://max.ucarecdn.com/b8a041fd-7dc0-47c2-a029-21dbcdbb22f9/-/format/auto/-/quality/lighter/-/resize/3000x/aboutheroimage.png)

Story

### Why we exist

Nonprofits deserve better technology.

This was the premise under which we launched in 2017. We’d encountered one too many donation forms that proved to be exercises in mental gymnastics rather than easy ways to give.

So we introduced nonprofits to the checkout, a technology typically used on e-commerce websites to increase sales conversion.

We hypothesized that the for-profit practices driving sales growth at retailers would similarly lead to greater giving for nonprofits. It was the right call.

![](https://ucarecdn.com/ba62e662-683f-4ba7-bae0-49a2a72bd770/-/format/auto/emoji.png) Today, nonprofits across the globe use Fundraise Up to improve the donor experience and increase revenue. The extra support means more help for the world’s greatest needs. And that’s what keeps us going.

Mission

### What we do

Everybody has an ability and willingness to give — we call it their generosity potential. Our mission is to unlock this potential by optimizing how people give.

We accomplish this through our donation platform. It helps nonprofits engage more supporters and grow revenue by providing easy ways to increase conversion, enable modern payment methods, and personalize the giving experience for every donor.

### Where we work

Built and based in Brooklyn, New York, Fundraise Up is a true NYC startup.

Now headquartered at [Industry City](https://industrycity.com/) , a sprawling campus of manufacturers, artisans, and technology companies like Fundraise Up, we collaborate in a space that connects our local, remote, and international teams.

In the neighborhood? Stop by for a visit. There’s lots to see and the drinks are on us.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 448 548'%3E%3C/svg%3E)![Industry City headquarters](https://max.ucarecdn.com/a52bf43c-f682-41ca-bd94-6ebee2683d5b/-/format/auto/-/quality/lighter/-/resize/896x/aboutheadquartersimage.png)

## FAQ

When was Fundraise Up founded?

Fundraise Up was founded in 2017.

Who uses Fundraise Up?

Fundraise Up is used by 3,500+ nonprofits worldwide, including organizations across international relief, animal welfare, environment, education, and faith-based fundraising.

Is Fundraise Up a CRM?

No. Fundraise Up is a donation and fundraising platform, not a CRM. It’s built to integrate with the CRM you already use, syncing donation data automatically rather than replacing your system of record.

Where is Fundraise Up based?

Fundraise Up is headquartered in Brooklyn, New York, with team members working locally, remotely, and internationally.
